title: rules.evidence.exported.v1
description: Written to the Rule Engine outbox in the transaction of every POST /rule-sets/{name}/evidence (PD-116), with the rule set's EVIDENCE_EXPORTED history entry: who exported which versions and decisions of which rule set, in which format, and the content's SHA-256. A replay with the same Idempotency-Key writes no second event. It never carries decision inputs or outputs. The outbox row id is the event id. Carries the full event envelope. Additive changes only within v1.

eventId.description: The event id, a ULID; equal to the outbox row id. Consumers de-duplicate by it.

occurredAt.description: When the export ran, ISO 8601 UTC.

tenantId.description: The tenant, from the authenticated context; never from a request body.

correlationId.description: The caller's correlation id (X-Correlation-Id, or the one passed to the Java API). When the caller gave none, the event id: the event starts its own chain.

causationId.description: The id of the command or event that caused this one, or null when a caller's command caused it directly.

producer.description: rule-engine, a slash and the engine version that wrote the event.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the envelope layout; 1 for every .v1 type.

versions.description: Version numbers exported, ascending; their history events are in the file.

decisionIds.description: Decision ids exported, in the order requested. Ids only; inputs and outputs stay in the decision log.

contentSha256.description: SHA-256 of the file's content, as written in the file and sent in X-Evidence-Sha256.

bytes.description: Size of the file in bytes.
